entities.summary: Carlik Anthony Jones is an American-born naturalized South Sudanese professional basketball player for Partizan Belgrade of the Basketball League of Serbia (KLS), the ABA League and the EuroLeague. He played college basketball for the Radford Highlanders and the Louisville Cardinals.
